headline: Share India Securities Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - We are pleased to inform you that the Company has received the certified true copy of the Rectification Order dated 12.10.2026 passed by the Hon'ble NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench -I along with the certified true copy of the…
detail: General Updates - We are pleased to inform you that the Company has received the certified true copy of the Rectification Order dated 12.10.2026 passed by the Hon'ble NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench -I along with the certified true copy of the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited.
